name: PIA Automation
summary: PIA Automation is an industrial automation group headquartered in Ningbo, China. It supplies manufacturing systems for automotive, energy-storage, medical and consumer-goods applications. The group also develops humanoid robot technology through its wholly owned AI and Humanoid Robotics Research Institute, whose published products include the JARVIS humanoid series. Its broader embodied-robotics activity includes joint research and manufacturing ventures.
